## History

As a member of the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), Peter Sloane was among the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) left devastated when a mix-up with paint numbers resulted in the hall being painted bright blue instead of green. However, the rest of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) community soon rallied around Peter and his fellow [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) in sympathy and support against the [Pyes](../codex/factions.md#pyes).

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P15](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0015), [v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040)_
